general.title: OMIX Seurat Pseudobulk
general.instructions:
Create one donor-level expression bundle for one selected cell type from a Seurat RDS. Upload one object with Seurat RDS, or attach one data asset containing exactly one .rds and leave the selector blank. Enter exact, case-sensitive donor, group, and cell-type metadata column names plus one cell-type value.

Use sum_counts for raw pseudobulk counts sent to OMIX DEG Analysis. Use mean_harmony_corrected_expression or mean_sctransform_expression only for compatible corrected expression sent to OMIX Limma Analysis. Keep the output matrix, Pseudobulk_Sample_Metadata.csv, and Pseudobulk_Manifest.dcf together.

categories.name: Input Object
categories.description: Provide exactly one Seurat RDS and identify its cell metadata.

categories.name: Cell Selection
categories.description: Select one exact cell type and optional cell-level filters.

categories.name: Aggregation and Handoff
categories.description: Choose the matrix semantics and corresponding downstream route.

categories.name: Advanced
categories.description: Override source layers or profile-retention controls only when justified by the object.

parameters.name: Seurat RDS
parameters.description: Optional explicit .rds upload or selection. Leave blank only when attached data contains exactly one RDS; the adapter then discovers it recursively.

parameters.name: Donor Metadata Column
parameters.description: Exact cell-metadata column identifying independent biological donors or replicates.

parameters.name: Experimental Group Column
parameters.description: Exact cell-metadata column identifying the experimental condition written as Group in the output metadata.

parameters.name: Cell-Type Metadata Column
parameters.description: Exact cell-metadata column containing cell-type labels.

parameters.name: Cell Type
parameters.description: One exact, case-sensitive cell-type value to retain and aggregate.

parameters.name: Additional Sample Metadata Columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated cell-metadata columns, such as Batch or Sex. Each must be non-missing and invariant within every donor-by-group profile.

parameters.name: Cell Filter Column
parameters.description: Optional exact cell-metadata column used for pre-aggregation filtering. Supply Cell Filter Values as well.

parameters.name: Cell Filter Values
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated values retained from Cell Filter Column. Supply both filter fields or leave both blank.

parameters.name: Aggregation Method
parameters.description: sum_counts writes raw pseudobulk for edgeR/voom; Harmony and SCTransform mean modes write continuous donor means for direct limma.

parameters.name: Source Assay
parameters.description: auto resolves to RNA for sum_counts, Harmony for Harmony-corrected means, and SCT for SCTransform means.

parameters.name: Source Layer
parameters.description: auto resolves to counts for sum_counts and data for continuous modes. SCTransform means require data.

parameters.name: Feature ID Column
parameters.description: Output feature-ID column. The current downstream OMIX handoff requires GeneName.

parameters.name: Minimum Cells Per Profile
parameters.description: Minimum selected cells required in each donor-by-group profile.

parameters.name: Insufficient-Cell Handling
parameters.description: error stops when any profile has too few cells. drop intentionally removes under-populated profiles.
